entities.name: Sejiri
entities.description: One of the seven continents of Zendikar, a vast icy tundra at the northern pole surrounded by cliffs.

entities.name: Benthidrix
entities.description: An ancient underwater shrine built by arctic merfolk, uncovered by Kozilek's passage.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose arrival in Sejiri altered the land and revealed ruins.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans that overran Sejiri and destroyed the Sejiri Skyclave.

entities.name: Ikiral
entities.description: A settlement and trading post in the ruins of a broken hedron.

entities.name: Kozilek's Ruin
entities.description: A region of rippled land and warped bedrock formed by Kozilek's arrival.

entities.name: Midnight Pass
entities.description: The only way to access Sejiri, navigable only with a merfolk navigator.

entities.name: Sejiri Skyclave
entities.description: A skyclave destroyed by an Eldrazi titan, now a floating ruined fortress.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: An ancient empire of which Murasa was once part.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped lure the Eldrazi to Zendikar to trap them.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped lure the Eldrazi to Zendikar to trap them.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped lure the Eldrazi to Zendikar to trap them.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker whose use of the Lithoform Core's healing power lets Sejiri recover.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: A source of healing power used by Nissa Revane.

events.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin lure the Eldrazi to Zendikar to trap them; an Eldrazi titan appears in Sejiri and destroys the last Skyclave, which is encased in polar ice.
events.quote: destroyed the last Skyclave with a thoughtless ﬂick of a tentacle

events.summary: Within two years of the Eldrazi's release, the entire continent of Sejiri is overrun and destroyed.
events.quote: the entire continent of Sejiri was overrun and destroyed

events.summary: After Nissa Revane uses the Lithoform Core's healing power, the continent slowly recovers.
